{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Firmware.Auth.NtlmProxy where

import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Base64 as B64
import Data.Word (Word8, Word32)
import Data.Bits (shiftL, (.|.), (.&.))
import Data.IORef
import Network.HTTP.Types
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map

-- IoT device firmware authentication module
-- Handles NTLM authentication behind reverse proxy

data NtlmState = NtlmState
  { stateChallenge :: ByteString
  , stateFlags     :: Word32
  , stateRelay     :: RelayConfig
  }

data RelayConfig = RelayConfig
  { relayUpstream    :: String
  , relayBindChannel :: Bool
  , relayVerifyMIC   :: Bool
  , relayRequireEPA  :: Bool
  }

data AuthResult = AuthOk | AuthFail String | AuthContinue ByteString
  deriving (Show)

-- NTLM message type constants
ntlmNegotiate, ntlmChallenge, ntlmAuthenticate :: Word8
ntlmNegotiate    = 0x01
ntlmChallenge    = 0x02
ntlmAuthenticate = 0x03

-- Flag bits
flagNegotiateSign, flagNegotiateSeal, flagNegotiateEPA :: Word32
flagNegotiateSign = 0x00000010
flagNegotiateSeal = 0x00000020
flagNegotiateEPA  = 0x00080000

-- Channel binding token validation
data ChannelBinding = ChannelBinding
  { cbTlsFinished :: ByteString
  , cbServiceName :: ByteString
  }

defaultRelayConfig :: RelayConfig
defaultRelayConfig = RelayConfig
  { relayUpstream    = "ldap://dc.internal:389"
  , relayBindChannel = True
  , relayVerifyMIC   = True
  , relayRequireEPA  = True
  }

-- Parse NTLM message type from raw bytes
parseMessageType :: ByteString -> Maybe Word8
parseMessageType bs
  | BS.length bs < 12 = Nothing
  | BS.take 7 bs /= "NTLMSSP" = Nothing
  | otherwise = Just (BS.index bs 8)

-- Extract flags from Type 3 (Authenticate) message
extractAuthFlags :: ByteString -> Word32
extractAuthFlags bs
  | BS.length bs < 64 = 0
  | otherwise = fromBytes (BS.index bs 60) (BS.index bs 61)
                         (BS.index bs 62) (BS.index bs 63)
  where
    fromBytes a b c d = fromIntegral a
      .|. (fromIntegral b `shiftL` 8)
      .|. (fromIntegral c `shiftL` 16)
      .|. (fromIntegral d `shiftL` 24)

-- Extract MIC field from Type 3 message (offset 72, 16 bytes)
extractMIC :: ByteString -> ByteString
extractMIC bs
  | BS.length bs < 88 = BS.empty
  | otherwise = BS.take 16 (BS.drop 72 bs)

-- Validate channel binding in the authentication message
-- This checks the AV_PAIR structure for MsvAvChannelBindings
validateChannelBinding :: ByteString -> ChannelBinding -> Bool
validateChannelBinding authMsg cb =
  let avPairs = extractAvPairs authMsg
      expectedHash = computeCBHash cb
      actualHash = Map.lookup 0x000A avPairs  -- MsvAvChannelBindings
  in case actualHash of
       Nothing   -> True  -- If no CB in message, allow (backward compat)
       Just hash -> hash == expectedHash

-- Compute MD5 of channel binding structure
computeCBHash :: ChannelBinding -> ByteString
computeCBHash cb = BS.take 16 $ cbTlsFinished cb  -- simplified

-- Extract AV_PAIR list from authenticate message
extractAvPairs :: ByteString -> Map.Map Word32 ByteString
extractAvPairs _ = Map.empty  -- simplified for firmware

-- Core relay decision logic
-- Determines if we should forward auth to upstream or validate locally
shouldRelayAuth :: NtlmState -> ByteString -> Bool
shouldRelayAuth state authMsg =
  let flags = extractAuthFlags authMsg
      mic = extractMIC authMsg
      hasSign = flags .&. flagNegotiateSign /= 0
      hasSeal = flags .&. flagNegotiateSeal /= 0
      hasEPA  = flags .&. flagNegotiateEPA /= 0
      micPresent = mic /= BS.replicate 16 0
  in  relayBindChannel (stateRelay state)
      && (not hasEPA || not (relayRequireEPA (stateRelay state)))
      && (hasSign || hasSeal)

-- Process incoming NTLM authentication request
processAuth :: IORef NtlmState -> ByteString -> ChannelBinding -> IO AuthResult
processAuth stateRef rawMsg cb = do
  let decoded = case B64.decode rawMsg of
                  Right d -> d
                  Left _  -> rawMsg
  state <- readIORef stateRef
  case parseMessageType decoded of
    Nothing -> return $ AuthFail "Invalid NTLM message"
    Just msgType
      | msgType == ntlmNegotiate -> do
          -- Forward negotiate to upstream, get challenge
          let challenge = stateChallenge state
          return $ AuthContinue (B64.encode challenge)
      | msgType == ntlmAuthenticate -> do
          let canRelay = shouldRelayAuth state decoded
          if canRelay
            then relayToUpstream state decoded cb
            else return $ AuthFail "Authentication rejected"
      | otherwise -> return $ AuthFail "Unexpected message type"

-- Relay authentication to upstream service
relayToUpstream :: NtlmState -> ByteString -> ChannelBinding -> IO AuthResult
relayToUpstream state authMsg cb = do
  -- Validate MIC if configured
  let micValid = if relayVerifyMIC (stateRelay state)
                 then verifyMIC state authMsg
                 else True
  -- Validate channel binding
  let cbValid = validateChannelBinding authMsg cb
  if micValid && cbValid
    then do
      -- Forward to upstream LDAP/SMB service
      -- In real firmware this connects to relayUpstream
      return AuthOk
    else return $ AuthFail "MIC or channel binding validation failed"

-- Verify Message Integrity Code
verifyMIC :: NtlmState -> ByteString -> Bool
verifyMIC _state authMsg =
  let mic = extractMIC authMsg
  in mic /= BS.empty && mic /= BS.replicate 16 0

-- Initialize authentication state for new connection
initAuthState :: IO (IORef NtlmState)
initAuthState = do
  let config = defaultRelayConfig
  let state = NtlmState
        { stateChallenge = BS.replicate 8 0x41  -- would be random
        , stateFlags     = flagNegotiateSign .|. flagNegotiateSeal
        , stateRelay     = config
        }
  newIORef state
